senses.sense_definition: Relating to or designed for people who are walking.

examples.text: The city council decided to build a new <w>pedestrian</w> crossing near the busy school entrance.
Many tourists enjoy walking through the <w>pedestrian</w> zone in the historic city center.

senses.sense_definition: Lacking inspiration or excitement; ordinary and dull.

examples.text: The movie received poor reviews because of its <w>pedestrian</w> plot and weak acting.
Despite the high budget, the director delivered a surprisingly <w>pedestrian</w> performance.

senses.sense_definition: Relating to simple, everyday physical movements used in modern dance.

examples.text: The choreographer incorporated <w>pedestrian</w> gestures to make the dance feel more relatable to the audience.
By using <w>pedestrian</w> movements, the artist challenged traditional ideas of what constitutes a dance performance.

senses.sense_definition: A person who is traveling on foot rather than by vehicle.

examples.text: Drivers must always yield to a <w>pedestrian</w> at a marked crosswalk.
The new bridge was built to provide a safe path for every <w>pedestrian</w> in the area.

senses.sense_definition: A person who participates in competitive walking or running events.

examples.text: The professional <w>pedestrian</w> completed the long-distance race in record time.
Historical records show that the <w>pedestrian</w> walked across the entire country in just one month.
